reviews.review_text:
Mariain Asia
Xiamen, China11 contributions
0
Overcharging - avoid the place
May 2026 • Solo
Saw the good reviews and came here for local seafood. Very disappointedt.
The restaurant is tiny, only a few tables, loved the vibe at first. but prices are far from “local.” The menu stated 200–370k per 0.5 kg. Fine — not cheap, but acceptable if you actually receive 0.5 kg.

What arrived was a very small portion: average shrimp and 8 tiny overcooked scallops (see photos). Then came the bill — full 0.5 kg charged for each dish.
I directly asked the owner if there was a mistake. He insisted those less than average portions were 0.5 kg. 

The craziest part? The day before I had massive imported scallops with caviar at a high-end restaurant nearby for much less money, 200k ( At SInfonia del Rey, restaurant called rhymes - RECOMMENDED, so delicious) 

This place relies on tourists not questioning the bill. The owner also pushes a “street kid turned social entrepreneur” story, which makes the blatant overcharging even more ironic.
Avoid this place. There are far better restaurants nearby with better food, better atmosphere, and honest pricing.
